title: Interactive dashboard
text: The zip-code choropleth dashboard is a Shiny app in this project. Deploy it to shinyapps.io or Posit Connect, then embed or link it here.

title: Interactive dashboard
text:
Run locally
From R, with the project root as working directory:
shiny::runApp("dashboard")

title: Interactive dashboard
text:
Deploy
rsconnect::deployApp("dashboard", appName = "fireinsurance")
After deployment, the app will be at https://YOUR_ACCOUNT_NAME.shinyapps.io/fireinsurance/.

title: Ransi Clark
text:
I study the fiscal, economic, and political impacts of domestic migratory waves, with a particular focus on the recent out-migration out of California caused by wildfires, pandemic, and high costs. I take a quantitative approach to these questions, producing spatially granular panel datasets, and analyzing them with estimators conscious of dynamic trends.
I also develop diagnostic and corrective tools for panel data analysis for more general settings, focusing on biases caused by parallel trend violations, composition changes between treatment and control sets, and overlap violations.
In a parallel strand of research, I design messaging experiments that investigate the American public’s hesitancy toward energy infrastructure and energy-intensive industry.
